source_description: The twenty five inductees to citizenship listen to the speakers before taking the oath of citizenship during the Constitution Day naturalization ceremony in the National Archives Rotunda on Sept. 15, 2023.
caption: New citizens raise their right hands during the Constitution Day naturalization ceremony in the Rotunda of the National Archives Building, Washington, D.C., September 15, 2023. Photograph: U.S. National Archives.
why_it_fits: A documentary photograph of a federal building as the place of a named public event; the Rotunda's arches and gilded gates are in view. The subjects are private people taking part in a public ceremony; none is a partisan figure.
notes: The source description says the inductees are listening before the oath; the photograph shows them with right hands raised, so the caption says only what is visible. The original is 1,200 px wide, so this rendition is 960 px; use the original for anything wider than 960 px. Faces of private people are identifiable.
